input.quote: 9. TRUELINK WARRANTIES. TrueLink represents and warrants that the Interface and all related software (i) is designed to be used before, on and after January l, 2000;
input.rationale: The only TrueLink warranty in the Agreement (Section 9) is a Year 2000 date-processing warranty; there is no warranty that the Interface or related software conforms to its documentation, no professional/workmanlike services warranty, no compliance-with-laws or malicious-code warranty from TrueLink, and no repair, re-performance or refund remedy. Section 11 (p0069) only requires TrueLink to use "the same degree of care, skill and prudence customarily exercised by it for its own operations" — a self-referential standard with no fixed period and no remedy, which does not reach even the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with repair, replace or refund). By contrast, Section 8 imposes compliance-with-laws and malicious-code warranties on Client only. The disclaimer at p0076 is prefaced "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT," so it does not swallow an express warranty and needs no carve-out edit; the gap is the absence of the warranty itself. Redline inserts the preferred performance warranty and remedy into Section 9, with the fallback periods offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Add a TrueLink performance/conformance warranty with a repair, re-perform or refund remedy to Section 9.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 only gives us a Year 2000 warranty and Section 11 measures TrueLink against its own internal practices, so we have no conformance warranty or remedy if the Interface or the Services fail. We have added our standard performance warranty (12 months for the software, 90 days for services, compliance with laws, no malicious code) with repair, re-performance or refund as the remedy; we can discuss a 90-day/30-day fallback if the longer periods are an issue.

ops.text: In addition, TrueLink represents and warrants that: (a) the Hosting Services, Support Services and any other agreed-upon services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with applicable industry standards; (b) for a period of twelve (12) months following the Effective Date, the Interface and all related software will conform in all material respects to its documentation and specifications, and for a period of ninety (90) days following performance, the Hosting Services and Support Services will conform in all material respects to their descriptions in this Agreement and the Exhibits hereto; (c) TrueLink will comply in all material respects with all laws applicable to its performance under this Agreement; and (d) the Interface and all related software will be free of viruses, worms, Trojan horses and other malicious code. Client's remedy for breach of the foregoing warranties is, at TrueLink's option, re-performance, repair or replacement of the non-conforming software or services, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming software or services.
